account-baseline.description: Per-account security baseline: EBS default encryption, S3 public access block, IAM password policy, Access Analyzer, optional GuardDuty.

aws-account.description: New member account in AWS Organizations (run against the management account).

vpc.description: VPC with public and private subnets per AZ, NAT (none/single/per-AZ), S3 gateway endpoint, flow logs, locked default security group.

ec2-instance.description: EC2 instance with IMDSv2, encrypted gp3 root volume, Session Manager role and a dedicated security group.

s3-bucket.description: Private S3 bucket: public access blocked, owner-enforced, encrypted, TLS-only, versioning and lifecycle rules.

s3-static-website.description: Static website: private bucket behind CloudFront (HTTPS, security headers) or a public S3 website endpoint.

efs.description: Encrypted EFS file system with mount targets in every private subnet and backups.

dynamodb-table.description: DynamoDB table with encryption, point-in-time recovery, optional TTL and streams. Deletion protection in production.

eks-cluster.description: EKS cluster (API auth mode, KMS secrets encryption, control plane logs) with a managed node group and core add-ons.

alb.description: Application Load Balancer with HTTP to HTTPS redirect, TLS 1.3 policy and an IP target group.

route53-zone.description: Public or private Route 53 hosted zone.

acm-certificate.description: ACM certificate with automatic Route 53 DNS validation or manual records.
